newsitem.title: CANADA: Future Shop says lawsuit without merit.
newsitem.headline: Future Shop says lawsuit without merit.

text.p: Future Shop Ltd said Tuesday a lawsuit against it by Digital Doc Services (Canada) Inc is without merit and an attempt to force a financial settlement.
Digital Doc said Monday it sued the electronics retailer for breach of contract and is seeking over C$100 million in damages.

Future Shop chief financial officer Gary Patterson said the company severed its contract with Digital Doc because Digital Doc did not perform. "This is an attempt to try to extract money from us....We have legal advice that this is totally, totally, totally without merit," he said.

Digital Doc said Monday that Future Shop terminated an agreement under which Digital Doc would organize and manage Future Shop's customer service operation. Digital Doc said the retailer accused it of not raising the working capital it had said it would.

Digital Doc said it is also seeking damages for loss of profits. Accordig to Digital Doc, Future Shop told it in September it was interested in buying a controlling stake in Digital Doc, causing other investors to "back away."
Future Shop then notified Digital Doc it was not interested in the deal and cancelled the customer service agreement.
